import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.api import handle_import
c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
initialize(c)
assert handle_import(c, {"contacts": []}) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0}
r = handle_import(c, {"contacts": [{"email": " A@B.com ", "name": " Al "}]})
assert r == {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0}
r = handle_import(c, {"contacts": [{"email": "a@b.com", "name": "Al"}, {"email": "c@d", "name": "C"}]})
assert r == {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1}, r
before = list_contacts(c)
bad = [[{"email": "x@y", "name": "X"}, {"email": "X@y", "name": "Z"}],
       [{"email": "x@y", "name": "X"}, {"email": "a@@b", "name": "Z"}],
       [{"email": "x@y", "name": "X"}, {"email": "a b@c", "name": "Z"}],
       [{"email": "x@y", "name": "X"}, {"email": "@c", "name": "Z"}],
       [{"email": "x@y", "name": "  "}],
       [{"email": "x@y"}], [{"email": "x@y", "name": "n", "z": 1}], ["x"], [{"email": 1, "name": "n"}]]
for b in bad:
    try: handle_import(c, {"contacts": b})
    except ValueError: pass
    else: raise AssertionError(b)
    assert list_contacts(c) == before
for p in [None, [], {}, {"contacts": "x"}, {"contacts": [], "x": 1}]:
    try: handle_import(c, p)
    except ValueError: pass
    else: raise AssertionError(p)
print("ok")
